description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/Listing/MigrateBulk. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Queues selected listings for migration to a target channel in bulk. ownerAgent: publication. Use when: Use when concrete listing ids and a target channel are already selected and the user wants to migrate/copy them in bulk. Input: data: MigrateBulkRequest. Main fields: ListingIds: int[], TargetId: int, listFrequencyMinutes: int, dontListUntil: DateTime?, reviewBeforePublishing: bool, createdBy: int, ignoreVero: bool, ignoreOOS: bool, optimizeTitle: bool, optimizeDescription: bool, optimizeFields: bool. Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId. UserDevice is optional HGRWeb client telemetry; AI chat and MCP must omit it and must not invent a device value. Output: Creates migration bulk jobs for the selected listing ids. Search terms: listing migratebulk. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires confirmed=true and impactConfirmed=true before execution. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally. Internal-only request fields are removed automatically before the HGRApi request is sent.
